classes.authority: a NAMED recorded authority (role/grant) — `who` names it
classes.internal: internal-only: an audience-bound service token or run token from the declared callers — `who` names them
classes.login: any authenticated principal (a session or a verified bearer token)
classes.public: callable with no credential — each carries a `why`; `review` = public today but should not be (the review list)

_meta.extract: verify/route_extract.py (stdlib do_* dispatch by AST incl. do_OPTIONS; FastAPI live app.routes) UNION verify/route_discover.py (RUNTIME: every path constant of each compiled stdlib module probed on the live service — helper- and table-dispatched routes included)
_meta.probe: verify/route_probe.py calls every non-public route anonymously; it must be refused (401/403). `sample`/`body` reach the gate of a handler that validates before authenticating (an ordering finding, listed in the review).
